$description: Chromasmith design-token source of truth (W3C DTCG format). Seeded from chromasmith-design/project/_ds/.../_ds_manifest.json plus every variable declared in chromasmith-22.html's :root (~50-98), its body.light override (~1263-1301), and the token block in desktop/library-ui.js (~695-776). Matched by computed value AND property role per docs/ui-workflow/STATE.md S1(a) (fontSize->--fs-*, spacing/gap->--sp-*, radius->--r*) — never by _ds var() name (fewer than 10% of wireframe declarations use one). Every app variable is either a token below ($extensions.chromasmith.appVar) or listed in design/token-conflicts.md. Generated by /tmp .../build_tokens.py — do not hand-edit without regenerating from source; see design/verify_tokens.py.

page.$description: App background. Dark default; light theme swaps to white.

chromasmith.decision: kept app value 2026-09-11: three-alpha border split is deliberate wireframe-driven UX (see :root comment), no DS equivalent to adopt

default.$description: Generic control border. Light theme value has no DTCG-exact DS match — see token-conflicts.md.

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: adopt DS (no second accent) — aliased to --acc in both modes

primaryAlt.$description: Now aliases --acc (DS: "no second brand accent"). Previously an invented off-palette blue (#4a9ddc/#1f68a0).

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: DS value in light, app value kept in dark (contrast)

success.$description: Light mode adopts DS --green-pine unchanged (10:1+ on white). Dark mode keeps the brighter app value — DS's literal is ~1.3:1 on the near-black --bg, effectively invisible.

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: DS value in light, app value kept in dark (contrast)

danger.$description: Light mode adopts DS --red-oxide unchanged (8:1+ on white). Dark mode keeps the brighter app value for the same contrast reason as --ok.

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: unified with library's hover-tint value; added missing light mode

hover.$description: Consolidated with desktop/library-ui.js's --hover-tint (same role, was 0.07 vs 0.08). Light mode was previously undefined entirely (fell through to the dark value) — now set.

serif.$description: Alias of --display kept for legacy rule compatibility.

chromasmith.decision: kept app value 2026-09-11: DS defines no monospace face; numerals/code have no DS analog

mono.$description: Numerals/code/build-stamp only. No DS equivalent — proposed new family, see conflicts.

chromasmith.decision: kept app value 2026-09-11: app's dense-editor type scale is a deliberately different rhythm from the DS's marketing/web scale, not a gap to close
kept app value 2026-09-11: dense-editor spacing scale (4px steps) vs DS's web rhythm — different context, not a gap to close
kept app value 2026-09-11: added specifically because DS's 5px/8px rungs didn't fit a popover row (see :root comment); not a gap

controlSm.$description: Small radius (menu/popover rows). Close to but not equal to DS --radius-xs (5px) — see conflicts.

chromasmith.decision: kept app value 2026-09-11: DS's cubic-bezier is documented specifically for the 0.95-scale press effect, not general-purpose easing

ease.$description: No exact DS match to --ease-standard — see conflicts.

chromasmith.decision: kept app value 2026-09-11: DS's 300ms is a page-fade duration; app's 200ms is a UI-transition duration — different context

durationSlow.$description: No exact DS match (DS --duration-fade is 300ms) — see conflicts.

safeAreaTop.$description: Overridable device safe-area inset, not a design-system concept — proposed exclusion, see conflicts.

safeAreaBottom.$description: Overridable device safe-area inset, not a design-system concept — proposed exclusion, see conflicts.

lift1.$description: No DS token matches this multi-layer recipe (DS --shadow-product is single-layer, imagery-only per DS guideline) — see conflicts.

lift2.$description: No DS token match — see conflicts.

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: dark value made an explicit token

fill.$description: Dark value made explicit in :root (was only the CSS var() inline fallback, never a real custom property).

chromasmith.decision: resolved 2026-09-11: dark value made an explicit token

shadow.$description: Light-theme-only; dark falls back inline. No DS equivalent — see conflicts.

hoverTint.$description: Library-scoped row hover overlay (desktop/library-ui.js:761/775). No DS equivalent, and no chromasmith-22.html sibling (that surface uses --hov instead) — see conflicts.
